defendants: Jeffrey Macomber, Secretary of CDCR (official capacity)
causes: Challenge to compelled treatment as unlawful restraint
key_facts: On parole since Dec. 2020. Over 5 years of treatment. No new convictions, no revocations, low risk. Repeated clinician turnover and administrative resets. No good-cause finding issued for continued retention.
procedural_status: Filed 02/23/2026 (Case No. C2602632). Proof of service on AG and DA. April 27, 2026: Court issued Order Denying Petition for Writ of Habeas Corpus Without Prejudice. Court held Petitioner failed to exhaust administrative remedies: certification by sex offender management professional and parole officer is a mandatory prerequisite to court review under PC §3008(d)(2). Denial without prejudice permits refiling after exhaustion. Case closed.
risk: Habeas vehicle challenge; admin. exhaustion argument — case decided on exhaustion grounds.
